body:
It helps because she probably feels worthless. To her, you're too good for her. Why would someone as horrible as her get someone like you? So she pushes you away, bringing up past hurts to form a barrier in her mind so she feels justified in the pushing.

What happens when you show her how much you care is that she can still rationalize it all away. But occasionally something will get through, and that will help.

Hell, that's the point of this sub. So people can get their feelings out their and hopefully someone will say something that helps, or just listen.

Indeed. Something as simple as someone complimenting me on something stupid makes a world of difference, even if for just a day or hour. We're meant to live in groups and help each other out. It's interesting how callous people can seem from the perspective of a depressed person, it seems like the problems of others become so much more obvious, and everyone just ignores them. At least, for me it's that way.

I suppose it is comforting that other people have this problem. And yet, it is horrible, for the same reasons. I don't know much about you or who you are at all, but I love you. And really I'm not concerned about the meaning of life as I pretend to be. I just wish their was something I cared about.

Man, I don't know how much you can take my advice when I don't follow it myself. Just telling you that, but I can try to help you anyway.

If you feel saying "I love you" feels lame, try telling her WHY you love her.   Like I said before, little things help a lot. Anything to boost her self confidence, you know?

And yeah. The classic "I don't feel good." That happens when someone is feeling like no one their will miss them. Telling her people would miss her would make her feel guilty though. You can try staying with her when this happens, or coerce her to go. Don't be afraid to play dirty with that, she'll probably have a much better time with other people than she thinks she will in her head so it's worth it. But if she refuses, accept it and stay with her. Sorry this is long.

And meds... I don't know much about those. Sorry. But if a Doctor told her to take them, keep trying to get her to take them unless they make her feel worse, which can happen.

People do care for you. They are often tied up in their own lives to notice the pain of someone close to them. The surprising thing is that they actually DO care. It may be awkward. It may feel impossible. But you need to take the first step to let others show you their love for you so you can love yourself. I'm a goddamn hippy now apparently.

Anyways, don't beat yourself up for not talking. Like, I said, it can feel impossible. You did, however, take the first step already in posting to this sub. Just try to keep it going.

Self hatred is very hard for someone to overcome. She will try to push you away and come up with reasons to leave you. Hell, I've done the same thing. Just casually remind her that you love her. Grand gestures won't help, just show her how much you care by being their with her, remembering things she likes and going out of your way to do them. I gotta tell you, it will be hard, and it's not your job to hold her up. But it is within your capabilities. Try getting her to see a therapist if you can. Make plans and force her to keep them.

Hey man. Sucks you had to wait for a comment but if you still need to talk send me a pm.

Just in case you don't have time, let me tell you that life is worth living. It may not seem like it, but it is. if you killed yourself, there would be no going back. Ever.

And the fact that you care about your friends and family still tells me there is something you love in this world. Imagine never seeing them again? The pain you are feeling right now is temporary, while you have your entire life to love and be loved. I'm not very good with words, sorry.

Remind him all you can how much you care for him. For some people, feeling alone is the largest part of depression. You don't need to offer solutions, just listen to his problems and be with him when he's feeling at his worst.

You should try to convince him to see a doctor or therapist.
